subject: Team scope consolidation & manager coverage — proposed mapping and comms
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Team scope consolidation & manager coverage — proposed mapping and comms

Hi all,

Attached is a first-pass proposal to consolidate overlapping team scopes across Model Serving, Runtime, and Integrations. The objective here is to reduce duplicated ownership (particularly around routing policies and rollout automation), clarify manager spans, and create a clean transition path for affected ICs so we can maintain velocity through Q2.

Key changes (high level):
- Fold the lightweight Routing & Fallback engineers from Integrations into Runtime (2 FTEs net moved).
- Combine Model Serving QA and Runtime QA into a single "Serving QA" pod that reports to Marcus.
- Move two Platform PMs into a single product cluster owned by me for roadmap alignment.

What I need from this group this week:
1) HR readiness: Laura — can you review the attached transition checklist for 1:1 plan and comp implications?
2) Manager spans: Soojin & Marcus — confirm you can absorb the added direct reports and whether you want an interim IC lead.
3) Communications: Tessa — propose a comms timeline and manager talking points (preferably under embargo until next Wed).

I expect some edits on role scopes and a few potential exceptions for people in rotational/sensitive hiring situations. Please comment in the Drive doc by EOD Wednesday. If we agree, I'd like to run a sandbox notification to managers Thursday and begin 1:1s starting Feb 15.

Attachments: org-mapping-proposal-v1.pdf; transition-checklist-v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Product Management
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 11:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Team scope consolidation & manager coverage — proposed mapping and comms

Rishi,

Thanks for the draft. I reviewed the checklist and added comments directly to the spreadsheet (page 2) with suggested 1:1 talking points and a standard severance / lateral-move template where applicable. High-level notes:

- Please highlight any role changes that include title changes or compensation adjustments — those will need a second-level approval and ~5 business days to process.
- For any ICs with active performance improvement plans (3 people flagged), we should not publish team-level comms until managers complete the scheduled check-ins; propose a short exception list.
- We should run a pay-equity snapshot before finalizing moves that materially change job family. I can get that to you by Wed afternoon.

I also cc'd Karen from our HR partner — I recommend they be on the transition 1:1s for any role that will change employment terms.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 14:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Team scope consolidation & manager coverage — proposed mapping and comms

Rishi / Soojin,

I can take the consolidated Serving QA and the two Routing engineers. Quick clarifications on scope and handoff:

- QA scope: does "Serving QA" include the customer-facing test suites that live in the tenant test harness? If so, we'll need an ops owner for nightly runs and a small maintenance plan (approx 0.3 FTE).
- Routing engineers: they currently own routing policy codex for Dedicated; we need to ensure sprint overlap doesn't create a ticket backlog. Recommend adding a 30-day buffer where Integrations keeps first review rights on edge cases.

On manager spans — I'm fine with +3 directs, but only with one appointed IC lead to handle day-to-day mentorship. If we can't fill an IC lead internally quick, I'll request a short-term contractor.

I'll post more comments in the Drive doc, but no blockers from my side on the moves listed.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 09:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Team scope consolidation & manager coverage — proposed mapping and comms

Team — a couple of sensitive notes I want on record before we finalize:

1) Manager bandwidth: my team includes two senior ICs who are on parental leave through March; that reduces my available mentoring capacity. If we push the go-live for manager-facing comms, we should align 1:1s for those directs with their expected return dates.
2) Performance reviews: four people in the impacted cohort are due for reviews in late Feb. If their reporting line changes before their review, we must decide which manager completes the cycle (current or new) — best practice says current manager completes any ongoing review cycle unless both managers agree.
3) Sensitive hires: one open requisition (Backend Engineer, req #BR-2203) is in offer stage for a candidate at Acme. Marcus/Tessa — please ensure we do not change hiring owner mid-offer.

I'll add these as constraints in the Drive doc. Laura — please confirm how we handle the review handoff logistically (HR task ownership).

Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Engineering Manager, Inference Integrations

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: Karen Lewis <karen.lewis@hrpartners.com>, Jai Singh <jai.singh@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 17:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Team scope consolidation & manager coverage — proposed mapping and comms

Thanks for the quick reviews — good feedback. To keep momentum but protect people in sensitive flows, here's the updated plan:

- Freeze public comms until Feb 17. Managers will receive an embargoed manager packet on Feb 11 with talking points and exceptions list.
- HR actions: Laura / Karen will run the pay-equity snapshot and confirm comp change turnaround time by Wed Feb 10. Any moves requiring comp change need explicit approval before we trigger 1:1s.
- Reviews: managers owning reviews at time of review completion will remain the reviewer. Soojin — please keep your review schedule; we'll not reassign mid-cycle unless mutually agreed.
- Hiring offers: no owner changes during active offer. Marcus — confirm you'll keep the Acme candidate flow.
- Manager coverage: Marcus to appoint an interim IC lead or request contractor by Feb 12.

Next steps:
1) Tessa — draft manager packet and comms timeline by EOD Thu (Feb 11).
2) Laura / Karen — comp snapshot + HR checklist by Wed (Feb 10).
3) Marcus — IC lead decision by Feb 12.
4) I'll schedule a 30-minute sync for Feb 12 to lock outstanding items.

If nothing material changes, we'll start manager 1:1s on Feb 15 and public comms Feb 17. Please reply only with blockers; otherwise I'll assume alignment and move forward.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Product Management
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: org-mapping-proposal-v1.pdf; transition-checklist-v1.xlsx
